statementSummary: Stated 2 armed men broke shutter at 02:15 AM and threatened guard with iron rod.
Saw black pulsar bike without number plate speeding towards Trinity Circle.
Returned home from wedding to find main door lock broken and gold ornaments missing.
Received call impersonating electricity board officer; OTP shared leading to Rs 4.5L debit.
Truck stopped by boulders on road; 3 men armed with knives attacked and looted cargo.
Rider snatched gold chain from behind while walking near Kadri temple gate.
Security camera captured two suspects loading copper rolls into pick-up van.
Received anonymous voice-modulated call demanding Rs 50 Lakhs protection money.
Identified suspect 'Chota Imran' at the scene wielding a sharp machete.
